podcast.body: "Cochise" was the first single released by Audioslave in 2002, appearing on their self-titled debut album. It marked the public introduction of the supergroup formed by Chris Cornell and the instrumental members of Rage Against the Machine. "AudioSlave from 2002, and the first single from their first of three albums."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: The official title of a song that originally appeared as "Take It Out On Me" on a bootleg CD featuring early recordings of the future Audioslave lineup. This track was part of the material created during the highly productive initial jam sessions with Chris Cornell. "The first track is called Take It Out On Me. But the time the album was released, it was called Cochise."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
